why: The trail tint stops excluding `campaign-coop`, so a FOUR-PLAYER CO-OP campaign board prints identity-tinted trails. This is the exact defect the first implementation shipped and a screenshot caught: co-op clears the player-count gate -- four player tanks, four identity rings -- so `identityApplies` alone is not enough, and issue #284's scope says campaign trails stay neutral in the initial implementation. Single-player campaign is NOT the discriminating case here (it fails the player-count gate either way), which is why the test uses four co-op tanks and asserts the same four ARE tinted in ffa -- otherwise the case would pass against a build that tinted nothing. Scoped to tread-trails.test.ts; expectFailures counts that scoped run only.
killedBy: tread trails carry their owner identity in VS (issue #284) leaves campaign trails neutral -- and for the same reason rings are
